comment: The UNI/BI switch looks inverted in the 2.0.3 source: the module adds a 5V offset to its inputs and subtracts it from its outputs when the switch is at UNI, which is the shift a bipolar signal needs rather than a unipolar one. The line follows the source and says that it contradicts the panel and the manual.
